diagram.documentation:
All gUFO annotations for gUFO classes that have notes stereotyped «Literal Annotation» by the CCM importer and that are connected to classes, attributes of classes, or packages.

This diagram only shows imported annotations that are connected to classes, attributes of classes, or the containing gUFO package. These correspond to annotations on the OWL classes and the ontology.

For imported annotations connected to imported RDF properties (which appear as UML association role names), see: TBC TBC gUFO Metamodel - Properties with annotations.

For relationships between classes, see: gUFO Metamodel - Classes full taxonomy per gUFO TTL incl. unions/intersections, constraints (Disjointness, Complement Of ), attributes , TBC TBC gUFO Metamodel - Non-taxonomic Relations Between Classes
